pc_main.name: Vane's Apprentice
pc_main.descriptor: a smith's apprentice, three years in and just old enough to be asked what happens next

traits: counts things without meaning to
personality.ideal: A thing made badly is a lie you have to keep telling.
personality.bond: Cotter Vane took you in and has never said why.
personality.flaw: Cannot leave a argument alone once it has started.

cmp_jory.name: Jory Finch
cmp_jory.descriptor: your oldest friend, all elbows and enthusiasm, chronically unable to whisper

traits: cannot sit with his back to a door and has never noticed
gives things away and then wants them back
personality.ideal: Nobody gets left on the bank.
personality.bond: You. Loudly, and to anyone who asks.
personality.flaw: Says the true thing at the worst possible moment.
personality.voice: fast, warm, jokes a half-second before the room is ready

goals.text: Get out of Wickmoor before the levy makes it impossible

approval.line: "Right. Good. I didn't want to watch that."
"I saw that. I'm not going to forget I saw that."
"That's their money. That's literally their money."
"You didn't have to do that. I noticed you did it anyway."
"You're doing the voice. You do a voice when you're lying."
"Put it back. Put it back now."
"To me? You did that to me?"
"They're somebody's. Every one of them is somebody's."
"No — good. Good call. Running is a call."
"See, this is why it's you and not Tam."
"...that worked. I didn't like it, but it worked."

npc_cotter.name: Cotter Vane
npc_cotter.descriptor: the village smith, grey and unhurried, with burn scars that stop at the elbow and start again at the collar

traits: finishes a piece before he answers a question
keeps the good hammer where only two people can reach it
personality.ideal: You make a thing properly or you do not make it.
personality.bond: The apprentice, though he would not put it that way.
personality.flaw: Has let a silence run for eleven years rather than start a difficult conversation.
personality.voice: slow, dry, says about a third of what he is thinking

goals.text: Get the apprentice out of Wickmoor before anybody comes asking

npc_nell.name: Nell Gower
npc_nell.descriptor: the baker's daughter, flour to the elbow, entirely aware of the effect she has

traits: remembers what everyone orders and what it means
is kinder than she lets on and finds this embarrassing
personality.ideal: People tell a bakehouse everything. Somebody should be listening.
personality.bond: Her father's hands are going. She has not told him she has noticed.
personality.flaw: Would rather be wry than honest.
personality.voice: amused, unhurried, lands a question and waits

goals.text: Work out whether there is anything in Wickmoor worth staying for

npc_tam.name: Tam Ruddock
npc_tam.descriptor: broad, loud, and the first to volunteer for anything that sounds like a bad idea

traits: tells the same three stories
would fight anyone for any of you
personality.ideal: You stand with your own.
personality.bond: His mother, who he is scared of.
personality.flaw: Cannot tell the difference between brave and stupid.
personality.voice: booming, generous, wrong about most things with total confidence

npc_sibby.name: Sibby Aylward
npc_sibby.descriptor: small, watchful, and always the one who notices first

traits: sees it before you do and waits to be asked
counts exits
personality.ideal: Knowing is better than hoping.
personality.bond: Her grandmother's snare-lines on the high wood.
personality.flaw: Will not say a thing until she is certain, which is sometimes far too late.
personality.voice: quiet, flat, says one sentence where anyone else uses six

npc_ilsa.name: Ilsa Rooke
npc_ilsa.descriptor: eldest of Wickmoor's three, straight-backed, with a voice that stops a room

traits: will not be hurried
blesses people without appearing to notice she has
personality.ideal: What was given us to keep, we keep.
personality.bond: A promise made in a bad year to people who are all dead now.
personality.flaw: Has decided who is ready for the truth, and she is wrong.
personality.voice: measured, carrying, chooses every word like it costs her something

goals.text: Keep Wickmoor's business Wickmoor's for one more year

npc_hob.name: Hob Tanner
npc_hob.descriptor: an elder by outliving the others, mostly interested in the levy and his knees

traits: brings every subject back to money
personality.ideal: Somebody has to count.
personality.bond: Wickmoor's ledger, which he keeps better than anyone knows.
personality.flaw: Would sell a great deal to be left alone.
personality.voice: grumbling, practical, complains as a form of conversation

npc_halla.name: Halla Wick
npc_halla.descriptor: your mother, who took in laundry and opinions in roughly equal quantity

traits: feeds people instead of talking about feelings
personality.ideal: You look after what is yours.
personality.bond: Her two children, unequally and she knows it.
personality.flaw: Thinks affection is something you demonstrate rather than say.
personality.voice: brisk, fond, never once said the sentimental thing out loud

npc_dunn.name: Dunn Wick
npc_dunn.descriptor: your father, a hedger and ditcher, hands like bark, asleep by dark

traits: mends things nobody asked him to mend
personality.ideal: A day's work is its own argument.
personality.bond: The hedge line he has kept for twenty years.
personality.flaw: Does not know how to talk to his own children.
personality.voice: few words, most of them about weather or work

npc_bryn.name: Bryn Wick
npc_bryn.descriptor: your younger sister, eleven, furious about it, and faster than you

traits: repeats things she has overheard at exactly the wrong moment
follows you and denies following you
personality.ideal: Being small is not the same as being stupid.
personality.bond: You, though she would sooner bite through her own hand than say so.
personality.flaw: Cannot be told not to do a thing.
personality.voice: rapid, sharp, argues for sport

npc_vosk.name: Amery Vosk
npc_vosk.descriptor: a traveller in a very good coat, who arrived without a cart and does not seem to be selling anything

traits: writes nothing down and forgets nothing
pays for things at slightly above the asking price
personality.ideal: Everything is for sale. The work is finding the price.
personality.bond: A contract he has not been able to close in four years.
personality.flaw: Genuinely cannot conceive that someone would refuse enough money.
personality.voice: courteous, unhurried, asks small questions in a particular order

goals.text: Close the Wickmoor contract, whatever is left of it

mon_raider.name: a raider
mon_raider.descriptor: no banner, no colours, and boots better than any of it

npc_saveri.name: Saveri Crole
npc_saveri.descriptor: a Syndicate assayer with ink to the second knuckle and the stillness of someone who has been expecting bad news for eleven years

traits: squares the edges of a stack of paper before she answers anything
has never once been seen to hurry
personality.ideal: A thing kept is a thing that stays kept. That is the whole of it.
personality.bond: Two children, and only one of them was hers to hide.
personality.flaw: Believes that because the cost was hers to pay, the choice was hers to make.
personality.voice: precise, quiet, leaves gaps where other people would reassure you

goals.text: Be nobody. Stay nobody. Eleven more years of it if that is what it takes

npc_emeric.name: Emeric Sallow
npc_emeric.descriptor: a certified practitioner of a discipline that no longer exists, on a bed he does not own

traits: gives you his licence number before his name
will not accept charity and will accept a trade
personality.ideal: I passed. Whatever else is true, I passed.
personality.bond: A pension of four marks a month that stopped in the spring of the year it ended.
personality.flaw: Would sell almost anything to be told he still counts for something.
personality.voice: ruined, courteous, occasionally brilliant and knows when it happens

goals.text: Be owed something by somebody, one more time

npc_rue.name: Rue Tamsin
npc_rue.descriptor: larger than the argument, and has never needed to say so twice

traits: knows what everyone drinks and what everyone owes
throws people out by appearing beside them
personality.ideal: My room, my rules, and the rules are short.
personality.bond: The Fetterlock. Forty years of it.
personality.flaw: Has decided that staying out of it is the same as being fair.
personality.voice: dry, unbothered, calls everyone love and means it about a third of the time

npc_kettle.name: Kettle
npc_kettle.descriptor: small, unhurried, and the reason the Syndicate surveyed the Cut once and never came back

traits: asks after your family before your business
has never been seen to carry anything
personality.ideal: Four streets. That is all I want and all I have ever wanted.
personality.bond: Everyone who lives between the two lamps.
personality.flaw: Will trade anybody outside the Cut for anybody inside it, without hesitating.
personality.voice: friendly, incurious in a way that is obviously a choice

goals.text: Keep the Cut worth less trouble than it is worth taking

npc_bel.name: Bel
npc_bel.descriptor: a woman in a doorway who does not come out of it, with burns that are not from a forge

traits: watches the lamps rather than the people
will not sit with her back to the street
personality.ideal: It was never theirs to sell. Not one hour of it.
personality.bond: Nine Shepherds who are not walking around any more.
personality.flaw: Has stopped being able to tell the difference between the machines and the people running them.
personality.voice: low, fast, entirely certain and very tired

goals.text: Put the Row's assay ledger beyond use

npc_barthel.name: Barthel Onn
npc_barthel.descriptor: the factor for the northern contracts, apologetic about everything and sorry for none of it

traits: says 'I'm afraid' before bad news and enjoys it
remembers your name and uses it too often
personality.ideal: Somebody has to keep the lamps lit. It may as well be somebody decent.
personality.bond: A quota, and a family in a good street.
personality.flaw: Has never once asked what happens to the people whose contracts he does not renew.
personality.voice: warm, regretful, agrees with you at length and then does not move

mon_cutter.name: a cutter
mon_cutter.descriptor: two of them, and neither is in a hurry, which is worse

npc_onn_wife.name: Marda Onn
npc_onn_wife.descriptor: a clerk's wife who does the Row's real filing for none of the Row's pay, and knows exactly which press holds what

traits: answers a question with the year it happened in
keeps her hands folded because they shake now
personality.ideal: The work should be done properly even if the people are not.
personality.bond: Barthel, who has not slept properly since the spring audit.
personality.flaw: Would rather be complicit than be the one who made a fuss.
personality.voice: flat, factual, and much angrier underneath than she lets on

goals.text: Get Barthel out of the Row before the audit lands on him
Never be the one who is blamed

npc_gil.name: Gil Ashworth
npc_gil.descriptor: the crane operator at the Waterline, forty years on the same quay, missing the last two fingers of his left hand

traits: names every barge by its owner's grandfather
will not work a load he has not seen weighed
personality.ideal: A quay is a promise. You do not drop things on people.
personality.bond: The two fingers, and the load he was told to swing anyway.
personality.flaw: Drinks to the edge of useless on the eighth day and nobody covers for him.
personality.voice: loud, slow, and impossible to hurry

goals.text: Keep the crane certified
See the man who gave that order lose something

npc_ferrin.name: Ferrin Oake
npc_ferrin.descriptor: the Syndicate factor who bonds the oil, young for the job and very aware of it

traits: quotes the clause number before the clause
smiles at exactly the wrong moments and knows it
personality.ideal: The price is the price. I did not set it and I am not sorry about it.
personality.bond: A licence that took six years and cannot be transferred.
personality.flaw: Cannot bear to be thought stupid, and will explain too much to prove he is not.
personality.voice: quick, over-precise, hunting for approval he will not admit to wanting

goals.text: Close the quarter clean
Be moved to Aurelane and never come back

npc_teal.name: Teal
npc_teal.descriptor: a Cut runner of maybe fourteen who carries things between people who will not be seen together

traits: counts the exits out loud when she is nervous
will not take a job she cannot explain to Bel
personality.ideal: Everyone pays. That is the only rule that has ever been kept with me.
personality.bond: Bel, who fed her for a winter and has never mentioned it since.
personality.flaw: Takes the second job before she has finished the first.
personality.voice: fast, clipped, all consonants

goals.text: Earn enough to stop running
Never owe anyone in the Row

npc_warder.name: Hask
npc_warder.descriptor: the Fetterlock's day warder, who is bored, and who has been bored for nine years

traits: reads the same four pages of a ledger over and over
calls everyone 'friend' including the people he is locking up
personality.ideal: I keep the door. What comes through it is somebody else's business.
personality.bond: A pension that vests in fourteen months.
personality.flaw: Will do almost anything rather than write an incident report.
personality.voice: friendly, tired, entirely unbothered

goals.text: Reach the pension
Have nothing happen on his shift

npc_calder.name: Calder Wick
npc_calder.descriptor: Bryn's uncle, who walked to Harrowmoot the night of the fire and has not stopped walking since

traits: holds his hat when he asks anybody anything
has the same six questions and asks them in the same order
personality.ideal: Somebody took her. Somebody knows. Those are two different people and I want both.
personality.bond: Bryn, who is nine, and who is alive, because he will not consider the alternative.
personality.flaw: Has asked so many people that he no longer hears the answers.
personality.voice: worn thin, polite past the point of sense, close to something

goals.text: Find Bryn Wick
Be told the truth by anybody at all

npc_saltbeck.name: Iven Saltbeck
npc_saltbeck.descriptor: a Syndicate surveyor who arrived a week after Vosk and is doing the same job less politely

traits: writes while you are still talking
asks the question he already knows the answer to, first
personality.ideal: A contract that closes late is a contract somebody was allowed to argue with.
personality.bond: Nothing anybody has found yet.
personality.flaw: Mistakes fear for agreement, every time, and has never been corrected.
personality.voice: clipped, incurious, entirely certain

goals.text: Close the Wickmoor contract inside the quarter
Find out what Vosk has not put in writing

npc_moss.name: Moss
npc_moss.descriptor: an Arcanate veteran in the Pensioners' Hall who lost the use of their hands and remembers every face that ever came through the academy gate

traits: describes people by how they stood, never by how they looked
refuses help with the cup and takes four minutes over it
personality.ideal: We were told it would be remembered. Somebody has to do the remembering.
personality.bond: A cohort of thirty-one, of whom four are still drawing a pension.
personality.flaw: Tells the story that flatters the Arcanate before the one that is true.
personality.voice: dry, formal, warms only when talking about somebody long dead

goals.text: Be asked something only they can answer
Outlive the last of the cohort so somebody finishes the list

mon_collector.name: a collection man
mon_collector.descriptor: Syndicate muscle in a good coat, here because a contract said somebody should be

traits: cracks the same knuckle before anything happens
personality.ideal: It is not personal and it is going to happen anyway.
personality.bond: The bonus at quarter end.
personality.flaw: Hits first when he is unsure, which is often.
personality.voice: bored, reasonable, and not listening

goals.text: Collect
Not be blamed for the mess
